items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: and then I made "Goody, Goody" with Frankie Lyman

ctx.x: Oh, it was a group? Vince Martin and the ...

Vince Martin, and this group. But I made "Cindy Oh Cindy," which was a big hit, and then I made "Goody, Goody" with Frankie Lyman, and I made "Summer Wind" with Wayne Newton, and I did "Big Girls Don't Cry," with the Four Seasons, and I did "Sherry," "Walk Like a Man," also the Four Seasons.
Were these done in New York?
